scope: all QROS/RISE conversational execution, research and engineering continuations
purpose: Make scientific progress independent of ChatGPT client rendering, message-delivery retries, reconnects, long-thread failures or volatile runtime loss.

transport_or_ui_failure_examples: user message appears unsent or is offered for retry after execution began
assistant/tool progress disappears from the client after reconnect

durability_rules.durable_definition: A result is closed only when recoverable from a durable store by exact identity/hash, not merely visible in chat or present in a volatile runtime.
durability_rules.expensive_unit_boundary: Each shard/group/chunk independently expensive enough to be undesirable to recompute must have its own receipt/checkpoint before the next such unit starts.

idempotent_retry_rules.client_retry_or_duplicate_user_order: Treat as continuation, not a fresh execution request, when durable authority and next action are unchanged.
idempotent_retry_rules.execution_capsule_identity: Bind campaign + stable authority blob/version + current checkpoint blob + exact next action + target/shard/group identity.
idempotent_retry_rules.duplicate_detection: If a PASS/FAIL receipt for the same execution capsule already exists and hashes validate, reuse it and advance; do not rerun.

heavy_execution_rules.background_or_detached_worker: May continue only if its progress is recoverable from receipts; chat visibility is informational only.

scientific_firewalls.note: This policy changes durability/execution control only and grants no scientific or economic authorization.
